findings.title: Return path analysis data not available
findings.description: PCB analysis did not include return path continuity data. Run the PCB analyzer with --full flag to enable GP-001 reference plane coverage checking.
findings.recommendation: Re-run PCB analysis with: python3 analyze_pcb.py <file> --full
findings.summary: Return path analysis data not available

findings.title: Decoupling cap too far from U311
findings.description: Nearest decoupling cap to U311 (PD2425J5050S2HF) is 10.0mm away. Each mm of trace adds 0.3-0.8 nH of loop inductance, reducing decoupling effectiveness at high frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Move decoupling cap within 2-3mm of U311 power pins.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap too far from U311

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J2A
findings.description: J2A (RADIO link) has 1 ground pin(s) for 5 signal pins. Recommended: at least 2 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J2A has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: F.Cu, In1.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers F.Cu and In1.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.

findings.title: ESD device D400 far from connector J10
findings.description: D400 (esd_ic) is 23.8mm from J10. Estimated pre-TVS trace inductance: ~17nH → ~624V overshoot during 8kV ESD strike (dI/dt = 37.5 GA/s). Recommended: <10mm.
findings.recommendation: Move D400 closer to J10. The ESD current path from connector to TVS should be as short as possible.
findings.summary: ESD device D400 far from connector J10
